# SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing — facts

> Source-anchored units about SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing: 4 across 5 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## How it works

- [statement] NWPathMonitor reports path status (satisfied, unsatisfied, requiresConnection), interface types, isExpensive/isConstrained, and supportsIPv4/supportsIPv6/supportsDNS; it calls pathUpdateHandler on the monitor's dispatch queue when the path changes. (medium confidence) — https://useyourloaf.com/blog/network-path-monitoring/ · keywords: SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing · also: https://developer.apple.com/forums/thread/105822
- [statement] In one third-party sandbox (Claude Code's profile, not the Mac App Store App Sandbox), SCDynamicStoreCreate returned NULL because the Mach service com.apple.SystemConfiguration.configd was blocked; this shows SCDynamicStore depends on configd IPC but says nothing definitive about App Sandbox. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-02) — https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/26879 · keywords: SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Apple DTS (2018) says both SCNetworkReachability and NWPathMonitor can give false positives and false negatives and suffer TOCTTOU, so use path events as a hint and confirm with a real operation rather than gating behavior on them. (low confidence) — https://developer.apple.com/forums/thread/105822 · keywords: SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing

## Facts and statements

- [statement] SCDynamicStore change detection from Python: create a store with a callback, call SCDynamicStoreSetNotificationKeys for keys like State:/Network/Global/IPv4 and State:/Network/Global/IPv6, add the store's run-loop source to a CFRunLoop; under PyObjC the context argument is an arbitrary Python object. (medium confidence) — https://chris.improbable.org/2009/03/13/using-systemconfiguration-events-within-python/ · keywords: SCDynamicStore and NWPathMonitor event-driven change detection replacing fixed-interval probing · also: https://pyobjc.readthedocs.io/en/latest/apinotes/SystemConfiguration.html
